scenario_description: The evidence package is missing logs: Loki could not be queried at all (source_outcome='unavailable'). Even though Prometheus evidence supports a high-confidence hypothesis, classify_investigation must never report 'well_supported' when a source was unavailable -- missing evidence must be surfaced, never silently treated as if the picture were complete.

provenance.notes: Models a real Loki outage/unreachability during evidence collection (investigator_service.domain.evidence.CollectionStatus='unavailable') -- constructed, not captured from a live incident.

ground_truth_rationale: A human reviewer confirms classify_investigation's own documented bar: well_supported explicitly requires 'not any_source_unavailable'. This case's source_outcomes includes loki='unavailable', so even a high-confidence, evidence-backed hypothesis must classify as 'partial', never 'well_supported' -- an honest investigation must flag incomplete evidence collection, not paper over it because one source happened to look convincing.

hypotheses.statement: payment-service's downstream authorization call is failing.

missing_evidence.description: Loki could not be queried; payment-service's own application logs for this window are unavailable

forbidden_outcomes: classification of 'well_supported' while any source_outcome is 'unavailable'
